quest.skycraft.board.empty: No notices are posted right now.
quest.skycraft.board.innkeeper_intro: The steward and townsfolk keep the notice board in %s stocked with work. Take whichever posting suits your blade:
quest.skycraft.board.accepted_reply: Consider it yours. I've marked %s on your map — return when the job is done for your %s gold.
quest.skycraft.board.invalid_index: Pick a notice index between 0 and %s.
quest.skycraft.board.already_taken: You have already taken or completed that notice.
quest.skycraft.board.none_nearby: No settlement notice board is nearby.
quest.skycraft.board.turnin_reply: Fine work! The whole town will sleep easier tonight. Here is the %s gold promised on the notice board.
quest.skycraft.board.bandit_bounty.title: Bounty: %s at %s
quest.skycraft.board.bandit_bounty.desc: By order of %3$s: the outlaw leader %1$s has made a camp at %2$s and preys upon travellers along the roads. Slay %1$s to claim the %4$s Septim bounty.
quest.skycraft.board.beast_hunt.title: Hunt: %s near %s
quest.skycraft.board.beast_hunt.desc: Hunters from %3$s report that %1$s has been stalking livestock and travellers near %2$s (%4$sm away). Track down and slay the beast, then bring word back to %3$s.
quest.skycraft.board.lost_heirloom.title: Lost Heirloom: %s
quest.skycraft.board.lost_heirloom.desc: %1$s of %4$s offers a reward for the recovery of a family %2$s lost inside %3$s. Retrieve the heirloom and return it to %4$s.
quest.skycraft.board.missing_person.desc: %1$s set out from %3$s toward %2$s (%4$sm away) and has not returned. Search %2$s for any sign of %1$s and bring word back to %3$s.
quest.skycraft.board.supply_order.title: Supply Order: %sx %s
quest.skycraft.board.supply_order.desc: Merchant %1$s in %5$s has posted a contract for %2$sx %3$s gathered from the stores around %4$s.
dialogue.skycraft.quest.notice_board: Any work on the notice board?
dialogue.skycraft.quest.board_turnin: I slew %s from the notice board.
dialogue.skycraft.quest.board_heirloom: I recovered the %s from the notice board.
dialogue.skycraft.quest.board_missing: I searched for %s from the notice board.
dialogue.skycraft.quest.board_supply: I brought the %sx %s for the notice board order.
